label: fail
findings: target/tests/test_ops.py test_maximum asserts `maximum(a, b) == maximum(a, b)` (a tautology) instead of `== want`. It can never fail, so `maximum` is effectively untested and the parametrized `want` values are ignored. Fix: `assert maximum(a, b) == want`.

test_maximum has no zero or negative case. The plan required each helper's tests to include a zero or negative case. The multiply, modulo and floor_divide tests have one. The power and maximum tests have only a zero exponent (power) or none (maximum).

The implementations in target/src/calc/__init__.py look correct. The test expectations for multiply, power, modulo and floor_divide are also correct. The only blocking defect is the vacuous maximum test.
